title: Skills optimization flight — skills/objectstack-ui: RESTRUCTURE (≈ −9,170 tok, −25%) — a 25.4k-token single entry file, dashboards taught in two sections 640 lines apart, a generated contract shipped twice, and the canonical dashboard example teaching two retired widget keys
body:
Member card of the skills catalog optimization program #14292 (maintainer mandate 2026-09-02, verbatim: 「审核所有的 skills，进行全面的优化。」). Filed by the skills lane seat (session `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`). Read-only audit at objectstack `origin/main` a59f78d. The full findings table is the audit record: the dev posts it verbatim as the first comment on this card at claim time (seat scratchpad `audit/objectstack-ui/findings.md`).

## Audit summary

`skills/objectstack-ui/` = **36,542 tokens**, 19.5% of the shipped bundle; `SKILL.md` alone **25,441** — 1.75× the next-largest authored file and 1.83× objectstack-data's entry file, which covers a comparable surface with 8 `rules/` files. Generated: `contracts/react-blocks.contract.json` 5,352 · `references/react-blocks.md` 3,153 · `references/_index.md` 1,205. Real usage (`= define<X>({`): `defineAction` 34 · `definePage` 29 · `defineView` 10 · `defineReport` 9 · `defineDataset` 6 · Dashboard literals 5 · `App.create` 3 · `defineCube` 1; page tiers structured 12 / html 3 / react 3 / slotted 1; view types grid 25 / simple 10 / kanban 4. Verdict **RESTRUCTURE**: single 25k entry file with no `rules/`; dashboards documented at `:654-796` and `:1437-1658`; `dateGranularity` content filed under `### Drilldown`; one generated contract shipped in two renderings.

## Incidental falsehoods (fix in this flight)

1. **`SKILL.md:1485`** — the canonical dashboard teaches `actionType: 'url', actionUrl: '…'` on a **widget**; both are `retiredKey(...)` = `z.never()` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts:382-384`; prescription `:309-320` "a dashboard widget has NO action button, and never had one"). Parse error AND tsc error; the sole blocker on the largest ungated example.
2. **`SKILL.md:1572`** — "Date bucketing lives on the dataset dimension, not the widget" — contradicted by `dashboard.zod.ts:217-225`: `options.dateGranularity` **overrides** the dataset dimension's default for this widget.
3. **Frontmatter `:13-14`** — "the React renderer implementation (lives in `packages/client-react`)": that package is React hooks for the client SDK; the renderer is `@object-ui/react-runtime` (objectui).

## Three funded additions

1. `filterBindings` construct (+170, paid by UI-D-05 + UI-D-06) — prevents the failure `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/dashboards/ops-dashboard.dashboard.ts:30-49` records verbatim (four tiles and a chart read 0 for any selection).
2. Widget `options` query keys (+120, paid by UI-D-08 + UI-D-03) — `dashboard.zod.ts:217-252`.
3. `os:check` marks on the four highest-traffic examples (+10, paid by UI-E-02).

## Flight scope

**IMPLEMENT** (same-file, shrink-only): every DELETE / MERGE-INTO / REWRITE-AS-CONSTRUCT / RETIRE row at HIGH or MED; the three funded additions; falsehoods 1–3; consolidate the two dashboard sections into one place inside `SKILL.md` (reorder is free); UI-A-02/A-03 routing-text corrections in the frontmatter (regenerate `skills/README.md`).

**ANCHOR RULINGS**: date macros / filter tokens — anchor is `objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` (query lists `date-macros.zod.ts` as a core schema); this package deletes `:1659-1768` and leaves a one-line pointer; if a TRUE row here is missing from query's table, list it in the PR body under "follow-up for objectstack-query" (note: this package's `:1706-1708` "unknown placeholders silently pass through" is FALSE — `packages/core/src/utils/filter-tokens.ts:44,378` throws `UnknownFilterTokenError` — delete it, do not port it). Relationships/objects → anchor `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (UI-C-03/C-04: delete + pointer). Action `ctx` → anchor `objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`. `timeSegments` (UI-D-02) → delete (non-spec, 0 usages); the objectui skill is the renderer's home.

**DEFER** (pending #14296): UI-B-01 split into `rules/` (item 1); UI-B-04 generated JSON rendering (item 3 — ⛔ do not touch generated files); UI-H-01 new eval file (item 2).

## Flight constraints (binding)

- ONE draft PR, first line `Fixes #<this card>`; governed ⇒ stays draft; review requests are the seat's step.
- Token ratchet: no ratcheted file may grow; additions paid by deletions in the SAME file; ⛔ re-wrap is not payment; ⛔ no ceiling raise; ⛔ no new files; ⛔ do not touch the ratchet script (this PR deletes no file).
- ⛔ Never edit another package's files: MERGE-INTO another package = DELETE here + one-line pointer; a missing/weaker anchor goes in the PR body under "follow-up for <package>".
- Generated files untouched (`references/_index.md`, `contracts/*`, `references/react-blocks.md`); frontmatter edits ⇒ regenerate `skills/README.md` (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-docs`).
- Live surface with zero measured usage ⇒ one row pointing at its schema, never delete the last mention; retired/tombstoned surface ⇒ delete.
- A false claim matching a spec `.describe()` string ⇒ file the spec-side twin as an out-of-scope card.
- Gates: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:skill-examples`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, plus `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands <changed paths>`; record the head sha.
- PR body: per-item 落点 | before | after list keyed by finding id; per-file token delta; `needs:contract-review` on both carriers (falsehoods 1–2 are contract-semantics corrections).

Refs: #14292 · #14296 · #13658.
